method: Falsifiable calls about points/loyalty landscape movement — bonuses expected to return, devaluations expected to land, sweet spots expected to close. Each has a concrete test and a real horizon date. Misses recorded honestly.

calls.call: The current Chase Ultimate Rewards → IHG One Rewards 70% transfer bonus (expiring 2026-08-31) will NOT be extended or replaced with any Chase→IHG transfer bonus before 2026-10-31.
calls.basis: Chase already stepped this promo down once — from a 100% early-bird (Jul 15-30) to 70% (Jul 31-Aug 31). Stepping down mid-campaign is a cool-off signal, not a warm-up. Historically Chase has left 3-6 month gaps between IHG promos.
calls.test: GRADE HIT if no Chase→IHG transfer bonus of any percentage is publicly offered between 2026-09-01 and 2026-10-31. GRADE MISS if any Chase→IHG bonus (>0%) is announced or live during that window.

calls.call: U.S. Bank will restore either Air France/KLM Flying Blue OR Qantas Frequent Flyer as an Altitude Reserve transfer partner by 2026-10-25.
calls.basis: Both partners went live on 2026-08-11 and were pulled roughly 24 hours later on 2026-08-12; Frequent Miler, Doctor of Credit and One Mile at a Time all characterise the removal as IT-integration failure rather than deal collapse. U.S. Bank waited eight months past its own December 2025 target to ship transfers at all — reputational cost of leaving these missing is high, and bank IT integration fixes typically land in 2–6 weeks. 10 weeks is a generous horizon.
calls.test: GRADE HIT if, at any point between 2026-08-16 and 2026-10-25 inclusive, either Air France/KLM Flying Blue or Qantas Frequent Flyer is publicly listed as an active transfer partner in the U.S. Bank Rewards Center for the Altitude Reserve card, evidenced by U.S. Bank's own transfer page or a Tier 1 confirmation. GRADE MISS if neither partner has been restored by end of day 2026-10-25 Pacific time.
